The '''1968–69 season''' is '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|66th season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|37th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

== Summary ==
The club won its 14th League title and second [[Three-peat#Spain|Three-peat]],.<ref>first achieved in 1963 which turned into a five-peat lasting until 1965. {{cite web|publisher=Diario Marca|title=La flor del Real Madrid Yé-yé|url=http://www.marca.com/2011/07/07/futbol/mas_futbol/1310030818.html?a=d4b430a7096e9c1309423dd461d4cc04&t=1354897168|access-date=7 December 2019}}</ref> The team set a record for the best start to a La Liga season with nine straight wins rounds<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2013/10/21/primera/1382311797_786593.html|title=Real Madrid 68–69 holds the nine victories record|language=Spanish|publisher=as.com}}</ref> the team clinched the trophy nine points above runners-up [[UD Las Palmas]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/especiales/2002/02/centenario/1955.html |title=Historia del Real Madrid, 100 años uno a uno|work=Diario El Mundo|access-date=7 December 2019}}</ref> The squad was defeated only once in 38 rounds by [[Elche CF]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.elchecf.es/noticia/aquel-elche-real-madrid-de-la-temporada-1968-69|publisher=elchecf.es|title=That Eclhe v Real Madrid from 1968–69 Season|language=Spanish}}</ref> Also, [[Amancio Amaro|Amancio]] won the [[Pichichi Trophy]] with 14 goals scored tied along [[José Eulogio Gárate]] from [[Atlético Madrid]].

Shockingly, the team was early eliminated in the Round of 16 of the [[1968–69 European Cup|European Cup]] by Austrian side [[Rapid Wien]] which won 1:0 in the first leg in [[Wien]] and advanced to Quarter-finals due to away goals after losing 1:2 in Madrid in.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/europa-league/2018/11/08/5be48204e2704e84138b460c.html|title=Fans of Rapid remember Real Madrid and 1968|work=Marca|location=Spain|language=Spanish}}</ref> In the [[1968-69 Copa del Generalísimo|Copa del Generalísimo]], the club was eliminated in the Round of 16 by [[Atlético Madrid]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.linguasport.com/futbol/nacional/copa/copa69.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030917233545/http://www.linguasport.com/futbol/nacional/copa/Copa69.htm |url-status=usurped |archive-date=17 September 2003 |title=Copa del Rey 1969|publisher=linguasport.com}}</ref>

The "Ye-yé" era started to collapse for this campaign as three members Araquistáin, Serena and Pachín were transferred out.
